name: Food Tourism Planner
description: Creates food-focused travel itineraries featuring local markets, signature dishes, cooking classes, and food district routing. Produces a day-by-day food itinerary with meal scheduling, neighborhood guides, and dietary accommodation notes. Use when the user asks about planning food experiences abroad, creating a food tour itinerary, finding local culinary highlights, or organizing cooking class trips. Do NOT use for general trip planning (use trip-itinerary-builder), restaurant reviews, or meal prep and cooking technique guidance (use home-household cooking skills).
